mission.name: First Blood (Human 1/3)
mission.briefing: Orc raiders have burned the outlying farms. Take your work crew and crush their camp before the war party grows.
mission.objective: Raze the orc encampment in the north-east.

ops.text: Lord Anduin: torch their hall, captain. Leave nothing standing.
Raze the orc encampment in the north-east.
Your keep has fallen. The campaign is lost.
